name: copilot-proxy
description: An OpenAI-compatible API gateway that validates API keys, enforces per-key model binding, and forwards requests to Copilot Connect.
author: Tony Xu <tony@tarch.ca>

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w ui
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w ui"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start -w server" "npm run preview -w ui"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
